description_en: Updates the effective scope of a built-in authoritative domain name zone in HTTPDNS
description_zh: 修改HTTPDNS内置权威域名zone生效范围
name: UpdateRecursionZoneEffectiveScope

parameters.description_en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. The token must be unique for each request. It can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.
parameters.description_zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
